title: Flutter Form validation state resets every keystroke
symptoms: Form error messages flicker or clear unexpectedly
FormState appears brand new each rebuild
cause: GlobalKey<FormState> is constructed inside build(), creating a new identity every rebuild and discarding FormState.
solution: Store a single GlobalKey<FormState> on the State class, as in the official form validation cookbook.
workaround: Use Form.of(context) from descendants if the key must live higher—but still avoid recreating keys each build.
